title: When the Protocol Falls
author: Sable Galloway
blurb: Theo Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
